result.description: A fictional ultra-wide studio monitor designed for architectural visualization, cinematic editing, and color-critical desktop work. The NOVA VEIL 34QX features a curved 34-inch panel with a 5120 x 2160 resolution, 10-bit color processing, and factory-calibrated wide-gamut coverage for demanding creative workflows. Its discreet chassis includes USB-C docking, adjustable height and tilt, and a low-glare anti-reflective coating for long editing sessions. Unlike performance-oriented gaming panels, this display emphasizes tonal accuracy, workspace clarity, and calm desktop integration.
